title: Nier: Automata PC Patch Bloats Game to 366GB, Surpassing GTA 6
description: A recent Nier: Automata PC patch meant to add languages accidentally bloated the game size to 366GB, sparking comparisons to GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Massive Storage Blunder for Nier Automata on PC

In a bizarre turn of events reported by IGN Games, the critically acclaimed action RPG *Nier: Automata* recently received a PC update designed to introduce new language support, including Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. While the intention was to expand the game's accessibility to a broader global audience, the execution hit a massive technical snag.

Due to an accidental packaging error during the update process, the game's file size skyrocketed to an astonishing 366GB on PC. Players rushing to update their games were met with a storage requirement that quickly filled up their hard drives, turning what should have been a routine language patch into a viral internet talking point.

## Putting 366GB Into Perspective: More Than 1.5 Copies of GTA 6

To understand just how massive 366GB is for a single video game, it helps to look at industry standards. Most modern AAA blockbusters range anywhere from 50GB to 150GB. To put this accidental bloat into a striking perspective, this single game size is equivalent to roughly 1.5 copies of GTA 6!

While Rockstar's highly anticipated *GTA 6* represents the pinnacle of massive open-world scope, detail, and next-gen assets, seeing *Nier: Automata* inadvertently dwarf such a massive upcoming release in pure file size has given the gaming community plenty of laughs. It is a stark reminder of how digital packaging mistakes can sometimes yield surreal results.

## Developers Working on a Fix

Fortunately, fans of the android adventures won't have to live with a 366GB monster on their SSDs forever. The development team has acknowledged the issue and is actively working on a fix to correct the bloated patch and restore the game to its proper, much lighter file size. PC players are advised to keep an eye out for the upcoming corrective update.

## Editor's Take
It is both hilarious and shocking to see a localized language update transform a relatively streamlined game into a 366GB storage hog. Comparing it to 1.5 copies of GTA 6 really puts the absurdity of the situation into focus. We hope the development team pushes out the fix swiftly to save our hard drives.
